title: Section A recall table and 6-mark question list
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y11 lesson 54 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Section A recall table and 6-mark question list)
intro: Lesson 54: Quick recall: Section A in one lesson. To understand which Section A facts and set passages I can recall quickly and which still need repair

questions.q: Explain the importance of the Hijrah for the Muslim community. (6 marks, our own question)
questions.a: Safety from persecution; a state in Madinah under the Prophet ﷺ; brotherhood of Muhajirun and Ansar; the start of the Islamic calendar; each developed.
questions.model: Point 1: safety and freedom to worship. Develop: the persecution in Makkah ended, and the first masjid at Quba was built. Point 2: a new community. Develop: the brotherhood of the Muhajirun and the Ansar.

questions.q: Recall sprint in the portal (ten questions on 1.1 to 1.9), self-mark in green; then a 6-mark answer in the response box on your weakest Section A topic, from the list on the pupil PDF. Start: 'One reason ... is ...'
questions.a: Recall answers per the key; a developed 6-mark answer with two points and evidence
questions.model: Teacher does recall question 1 aloud: 'Who was the Prophet's ﷺ wet nurse? Halimah.'

questions.q: add the set passage to your 6-mark answer.
Which Section A topic is your weakest now?
